reason: Refresh adds touch home screens and OWL widgets absent from the proved October 13 payload.
delivery: Exact-image initramfs payload copied into the RAM overlay before graphical.target; existing upstream freedreno and Hyprland retained.

packages.omamobile-shell: Stage pinned shell and runtime tools; retain upstream licenses including the GPL squeekboard layout.
packages.omamobile-omarchy: Apply and reverse-verify the pinned patches offline against the actual read-only coral lower; ship only changed files.
packages.omamobile-owl-widgets: Stage the hash-checked pinned widget store for home screens.
packages.omamobile-firstboot: Build staging artifact only. Existing account, key-only USB SSH, getty autologin and RAM setup replace the upstream user/firewall/storage provisioning.
packages.omaphone: Inventory only: depends on omatel-agent>=0.2.1, GTK4, libadwaita and sqlite. Coral telephony is unproved and this app is outside the desktop payload.
packages.omamobile-apps: Omit the cheetah camera, NFC and GNSS app metapackage: those devices have no coral proof.
packages.mesa/hyprland: Use the lower rootfs packages. Never stage the cheetah Mali/Panthor variants. No vulkan-freedreno.
